major.title: Nested caller safety and canonical claims bypass the input boundary
evidence: diagnostic-context-feature-snapshot-v1.ts:264-274 checks forbidden caller keys only at the input root
diagnostic-context-feature-snapshot-v1.ts:281-298 accepts decision_identity objects containing undeclared nested keys
diagnostic-context-feature-snapshot-v1.ts:647 preserves the widened decision_identity with structuredClone
A clean-room probe added decision_identity.canonical=true and received taxonomy=mapped with the field preserved
major.impact: A caller can assert a prohibited safety or canonical claim inside an accepted nested object, so the contract does not enforce the caller-claim prohibition as a closed recursive boundary.
major.required_follow_up: Add strict closed schemas or recursive forbidden-key rejection for every caller-controlled object, add collision tests, then create a successor freeze and independent re-review.

major.title: The public core contract permits caller-self-authorized trust-root substitution
evidence: diagnostic-context-feature-snapshot-v1.ts:244-262 exports a trust-root derivation over caller-supplied normalized, replay, calendar, decision-source and source-decision identities
diagnostic-context-feature-snapshot-v1.ts:470-477 checks only internal consistency with that caller-derivable root
A clean-room probe substituted normalized/replay/calendar roots, recomputed the exported trust root, and received taxonomy=mapped
major.impact: The core contract proves internal consistency but not external authority. A self-consistent substituted source bundle can be represented as mapped unless every caller uses the fixture adapter's separately pinned roots.
major.required_follow_up: Require a verifier-supplied trusted root or allowlist outside the untrusted input, separate trust-root construction from verification, add substitution tests, then refreeze and re-review.

major.title: Observation timestamps are not bounded by the latest finalized bucket
evidence: diagnostic-context-feature-snapshot-v1.ts:439-453 validates provider and observation timestamps only against the decision instant
diagnostic-context-feature-snapshot-v1.ts:589-593 derives latest_finalized_bucket_unix_ns but does not use it as an observation cutoff
A clean-room probe placed an observation at decision minus one second while the two-second watermark made the latest finalized bucket decision minus two seconds; taxonomy remained mapped
major.impact: A mapped snapshot can bind observation evidence from an unfinalized interval even though it reports an earlier latest finalized bucket, weakening the exact point-in-time and candle-finalization guarantee.
major.required_follow_up: Validate applicable observation and bucket timestamps against the derived finalized cutoff, distinguish provider receipt timestamps from bucket observations, add ±1 ns boundary tests, then refreeze and re-review.

next_action.purpose: Remediate N2-001 through N2-003 in separately versioned successor artifacts and perform a fresh freeze/re-review before defining any outcome join.
